text:
maya: Heads-up: saw cert-rotator failures for eu-west1 edge hosts around 03:05 UTC. Many renewals stuck in PENDING.
ankur: Any logs? Could be KMS decrypt or a keystore perms issue.
maya: Paste from rotator logs:
```
2026-03-22T03:05:11Z cert-rotator ERROR KMSAccessDenied: projects/redwood-prod/locations/europe/keyRings/edge-eu/cryptoKeys/rotator: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Context: IAMBindingNotPresent
```
liz-martin: I'm seeing a recent run of the iam-pruner job at 03:00 UTC that removed several non-conforming bindings. It matched any SA not ending in `-svc` and removed them. Looks like cert-rotator SA was treated as nonconforming.
tom: Oof. We deployed a tighter naming policy last week; the pruner used a denylist/allowlist mismatch. I can revert the pruner run but we should treat that as mitigation only.
raj: Our logging is another problem: KMS DATA_ACCESS logs are not sent to security logs (we only route ADMIN_ACTIVITY). So we don't have the decrypt denies in the central sink to trigger alerts.
ankur: Why are we filtering DATA_ACCESS? I thought we left KMS keys as an exception.
maya: The sink config was conservative for cost reasons. We disabled DATA_ACCESS broadly and only left it on for a very small set of keys. edge-eu keyring wasn't in that set.
liz-martin: Mitigation timeline: I re-granted roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to cert-rotator SA and manually triggered a rotation; renewals completed by 03:20 UTC. No customer-facing impact recorded but still bad.
tom: Agreed. Proposed remediation: 1) fix iam-pruner regex to include cert-rotator naming OR add explicit exemption; 2) add DATA_ACCESS sink for edge-eu keyring with 30d retention; 3) CI smoke test that ensures cert-rotator SA can decrypt a test blob before canary; 4) alert on KMS DecryptDenied aggregated metric.
raj: Add that we should record an incident annotation whenever automatic rotation fails for any Dedicated or Private deployments. Customers expect proactive notification.
ankur: I'll open the allowlist PR (IAM-PR #589) to add explicit exemptions and loosen the prune rule for service accounts with `cert-` prefix.
maya: I'll file INFRA-3802 for the logging sink change and set 30d retention.
liz-martin: I'll add ROTATOR-CI-15 to insert a quick decrypt check in the pipeline (owner: liz-martin). Also adding a small runbook entry for on-call so they don't manually re-grant perms without checking pruner logs.
tom: I'll make ALERT-130 (3 denies in 5m -> pager). Also add a dashboard tile with decrypt deny rate by key.
raj: Let's also schedule a post-deploy IAM audit that runs daily and tickets drift to #eng-security. That should catch future accidental removals.
maya: One more note: this incident shows we need better naming conventions or stronger exemptions for infra service accounts. Long-term action: central registry of infra SAs and required roles. I'll spin up a doc backlog item.
infra-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0313-02 (owner: liz-martin).
liz-martin: Thanks. Follow-ups tracked: INFRA-3802 (logging sink), IAM-PR #589 (pruner exemptions), ROTATOR-CI-15 (smoke test), ALERT-130 (kms decrypt denies).
raj: I'll draft a short RCA and postmortem once IAM-PR is confirmed.
ankur: Pulling the pruner change into review now. ETA: today afternoon.
